text: Figure 10.13: Use case Report Supervision Failure Name: Report Supervision Failure Description: This use case describes reporting a supervision failure. Triggering Event: The use case is triggered by a supervision failure detected by Platform Health Management . Participating Actors: State Management State Management participates in this use case by handling recovery . Extending use cases: Fire Watchdog Reaction Fire Watchdog Reaction extends this use case if the supervision failure cannot be handled by State Management . Preconditions: • State Management has enabled potential invocation of RecoveryHandler() by calling the method Offer().
